description: Sidewalk Construction Program is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. The City of Toronto's Missing Sidewalk Installation Program Dataset illustrates the locations and details of planned sidewalks scheduled for construction in the near term along all transportation corridors within the City of Toronto limits. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are missingsidewalk, sidewalk, sidewalkprogram, torontosidewalk. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
